transforms.name: hostRunFromSummary
transforms.effect: Copies profileId and profileSet. It never sets account, so a VibeField row cannot carry the field.

transforms.name: deriveAgentRow
transforms.effect: Copies host.account onto the row only when the host set it. Here the host did not.

transforms.name: monitorHostRun
transforms.effect: Puppeteer Godview host only. account is accountLabel(profileId) when profileId is set and the label is non-empty. Otherwise the field stays absent. The VibeField host never calls this.

transforms.name: accountUsageView
transforms.effect: accountUsage profile labels feed the usage column. They are not written to field.account.

transforms.name: createMonitorBackend
transforms.effect: fieldd hosts the monitor backend on the runtime source and passes the current-epoch cost reading.

transforms.name: wireMonitorRow
transforms.effect: The model wire drops device.self. This desktop's window otherwise reads the row whole.

transforms.name: peerMonitorRow
transforms.effect: A peer loses project.seq and has detail, activity line, wait text, and reply text bounded.

transforms.name: modelRowFrom
transforms.effect: The reader restores device.self and fills a missing writable from attachable.

transforms.name: window-rows
transforms.effect: No display rewrite for this field. The row is spread through, aside from peer stale and peer profileSet.

defaults.when: this adapter's traced producers do not supply the row field

applicability.notes: sourceScope=host-supplied. sourceRef=packages/monitor/src/backend/derive.ts:273 host.account copy. staticPresence=host-dependent. Envelope classification.uiReachable=no is the VibeField host only. hostRunFromSummary (packages/fieldd/src/agent-monitor.ts:223-266) copies profileId and profileSet and never account, so the value is never supplied. AgentList.tsx:151 and :185 read agent.account when it is present, and that reader does not make the value reachable under this host. This is not a global absence. Under the Puppeteer Godview host, monitorHostRun (apps/godview/src/main/monitor-host.ts:62,79) sets account from accountLabel(profileId) only when profileId is set and that label is non-empty. A profiles service (providers.ts:317) can supply that profile. A run with no profile leaves the field absent. accountUsage (no accountUsage service) feeds the usage column (packages/views/src/usage/account-usage.ts:63-82), not field.account.
